Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <8uniah$r0r$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

Ethan Burrow <saa...@yahoo.com> wrote:
>Does Oubliette at the superior still burn blood/life if combat was
>ended at long range?

Effects associated with a Combat Ends strike happen after the combat
ends [RTR 19970630], so range is irrelevant. Note that Catatonic Fear
and Riposte have specific text to override this (by errata, in Riposte's
case). In the absence of such text on Oubliette, its 'burn blood/life'
effect at superior disregards the range at which the combat was ended.

Note that this is listed in Clarification Green at the VTES site
(www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulings.html), for some reason.

LSJ, have I missed something? Does the general rule of "Strikes only
affect the opposing minion if at close range, barring R after damage
or the word 'ranged'" stay in effect even after the combat ends? It
seems to me (and I'm certainly open to error) that the concept of 'range'
ceases to have meaning after combat is over, and therefore ancillary
effects of Combat Ends strikes ignore range barring specific text.

gomi
